items.why: Better than the raw head: the collapse only removes the break, keeps the same words, and gives the review body's full name. The tender list filters (winner/buyer/bidder) return nothing for this org because it only appears as a review body (Lot-ReviewOrg). I took three tender ids that name it from earlier local cache files (ids only, no verdicts) and re-fetched each one live. T 7943791 (00601687-2026, published 2026-09-01, newest) prints 'Vergabekammer Rheinland-Pfalz beim Ministerium für Wirtschaft, Verkehr, Landwirtschaft und Weinbau', the same name with 'beim' for 'bei dem', so the ministry name is still current. T 72821 (00200726-2025, 2025-03-28) prints 'Vergabekammer Ministerium für Wirtschaft, Verkehr, Landwirtschaft und Weinbau', which leaves out 'Rheinland-Pfalz'. T 990997 (00783545-2023, 2023-12-22) prints the raw head exactly, with the line break before 'bei dem'. The break falls between name and attribution, so collapsing it does not merge different fields. The org record /v1/organizations/22289866 currently serves the raw head.

Better than the raw head: same words with the break removed, and it is the school's full proper name. Read as buyer; the list has 3 items and more=false. T 547533 (00423127-2026, 2026-06-19) prints Procedure-Buyer 'Szkoła Podstawowa nr 13 z Oddziałami Dwujęzycznymi'. T 484722 (00050439-2026, 2026-01-23) and T 1036539 (00176979-2025, 2025-03-19) print the same short form. That short form drops 'im. Jana III Sobieskiego w Tychach' but matches the first part of the head exactly, so it is the same school. Collapsing only joins the full name across its line break ('...Dwujęzycznymi im. Jana III Sobieskiego w Tychach'), and no other field is glued in.

Better than the raw head: same words with the break removed, and the result is a spelling the buyer itself printed. Read as buyer, newest 5 tenders. T 1071850 (00115949-2026, 2026-02-18), T 441573 (00112125-2026, 2026-02-17), T 72613 (00027919-2026, 2026-01-15) and T 848552 (00797221-2025, 2025-12-02) print 'ZESPÓŁ SZKÓŁ CENTRUM KSZTAŁCENIA ROLNICZEGO IM. WŁADYSŁAWA STANISŁAWA REYMONTA W SOKOŁOWIE PODLASKIM', i.e. the same school with the patron's names written out. T 898904 (00676251-2025, 2025-10-15) prints exactly the collapsed new_name, 'Zespół Szkół Centrum Kształcenia Rolniczego im. Wł. St. Reymonta w Sokołowie Podlaskim'. Collapsing therefore produces a printed, correct full name, and nothing false is glued in.

Better than the raw head: same words with the break removed, and the full patron name is kept. Read as buyer; only 2 procedures exist (more=false). T 1045248 (00448995-2026, 2026-06-30, newest) prints Procedure-Buyer 'Zespół Szkół Centrum Kształcenia Rolniczego im. Wł. St. Reymonta w Dobryszycach', the same school with abbreviated patron names. T 1017612 (00053168-2026, 2026-01-23) prints the raw head exactly, with a line break before 'im. Władysława Stanisława Reymonta w Dobryszycach'. The break sits inside one name, so the collapse 'Zespół Szkół Centrum Kształcenia Rolniczego im. Władysława Stanisława Reymonta w Dobryszycach' is the school's complete name, with nothing glued in.

VAT DE157997318. The City of Dresden's new 2026 awards all print 'BAUHAUF GmbH' as tenderer: t237350 (notices 2026-01-23 and 2026-01-26), t517925 (2026-03-11, 2026-03-12), t410637 (2026-04-02, 2026-04-03) and t373721 (2026-05-06, 2026-05-07). Weak case for right: the 2026-08-20 modification is the newest notice overall and still prints the head, so neutral is defensible.

AFM 069206803 has a valid check digit. Its 8-digit form 69206803 is in the natural-person range (legal entities' old AFMs start with 9), so it denotes a person, not the union. A Greek 'Ένωση οικονομικών φορέων' has no AFM of its own. The head is the consortium text 'Ένωση οικονομικών φορέων: "1. ΕΔΑΦΟΣ - ΣΥΜΒΟΥΛΟΙ ΜΗΧΑΝΙΚΟΙ ΑΕ, 2. G.T.B. ΑΝΟΔΟΣ ... 3. ΟΜΙΛΟΣ ΤΕΧΝΙΚΩΝ ΜΕΛΕΤΩΝ ΑΤΕ ..."' from t1087663 (2024-08-14) only. The newer t277566 (Πανεπιστήμιο Δυτικής Αττικής research equipment, LOT-0100 'Συσκευή Άμεσης Διάτμησης ... Μερικώς Κορεσμένα Εδάφη') prints 'ΜΠΑΡΔΑΝΗΣ ΜΙΧΑΗΛ' as tenderer on notices 2025-08-25, 2025-11-05 and 2026-01-19.
